equipment.description: 3-ton, 208/230 V single-phase split-system air conditioner, R-410A, scroll compressor, TXV

scenarios.title: Warm air: compressor side of the run capacitor has failed
No cooling: contactor coil is open
Warm air: outdoor fan motor has an open winding
Weak, warm airflow: clogged filter and frosted indoor coil
Poor cooling: system is low on refrigerant
No cooling: outdoor disconnect left in the OFF position
Intermittent cooling: outdoor coil is blocked with debris
No cooling: low-voltage cable to the outdoor unit is cut
